items.q: Whose turn is it to do the watering this week?

items.answer: Four tasks are overdue: "Cut back the boundary hedge" (Dot, due Sun 28 Feb, 16 days late), "Clear the drainage ditch" (Hal, due Mon 1 Mar, 15 days late), "Return the borrowed rotavator" (Josef, due Wed 10 Mar, 6 days late) and "Renew the public liability insurance" (Tomas, due Sun 14 Mar, 2 days late, waiting on broker).

items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Priya needs to book the skip for the clear-out (due Wed 17 Mar, still "to do") and send round the AGM minutes (due Thu 18 Mar, "under way"). Her third task, drafting the open day leaflet, is due Fri 2 Apr, after the meeting.

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: Yes. Two tasks are waiting on the council. "Get the water meter replaced" (Hal, due Thu 25 Mar, waiting) is waiting on council. "Fix the main gate lock" (Wren, due Mon 22 Mar, waiting) is waiting on Council (estates team).

items.q: Who is going to repaint the noticeboard?
items.answer: Nobody. The page lists "Repaint the noticeboard" under "Nobody's name on it" as "nobody yet", due Sat 10 Apr and still to do.

items.q: How many loads of manure are being ordered?

items.answer: Josef is strimming the top half of the paths and Dot is strimming the bottom half. Both jobs are due Sat 20 Mar and both are still "to do".
